analysis_scope.coverage_threshold_ranking: Cumulative submitted function-group denominator within each contract subset.
analysis_scope.testcase_effectiveness: Per-model unique (benchmark_id, signature) evaluations actually replayed. No cross-model pooling or deduplication is performed.

coverage_threshold_ranking.denominator_note: Unlike testcase-effectiveness results, ranking sensitivity is cumulative over every submitted function group in selected contracts. Missing, non-compiling, or unrecovered functions contribute zero equivalent functions.

denominators.scope_note: Mismatch effectiveness is evaluated separately for this model over unique (benchmark_id, signature) pairs that were actually replayed. Missing or non-compiling functions have no case-level observations and are excluded here.

definitions.additional_detections_beyond_random: Failing model-function evaluations detected by this category for which random cases did not detect a mismatch. Augmented categories may overlap each other.
definitions.exclusive_detection_removal_loss: Failing model-function evaluations detected by this category and no other; these failures would be missed if the category were removed.
definitions.order_independent_shapley_credit: For each failing model-function evaluation detected by k categories, each detecting category receives 1/k credit. Credits sum to all detected failures.

mismatch_modalities.comparison_note: Modalities reconstruct the evaluator exactly: success/revert status, returned or revert bytes, ordered logs, and storage_changes for non-view/non-pure calls.
